name: Agorapulse
description: Agorapulse is a social media management platform for publishing, engagement, listening, collaboration, and performance reporting across connected social profiles.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-generated API key from an Open API-enabled Custom plan, bind it to one exact organization and workspace, and let agents inspect bounded profile references and aggregate analytics through four approval-gated tools.

credentialRequirements.name: AGORAPULSE_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Agorapulse API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate a dedicated key in Personal settings > API Keys. Relay encrypts it and sends it only to the fixed Agorapulse API origin.

credentialRequirements.name: AGORAPULSE_ORGANIZATION_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Agorapulse organization ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use Get manager organizations in the official API documentation and paste one exact organization ID.

credentialRequirements.name: AGORAPULSE_WORKSPACE_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Agorapulse workspace ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use Get organization workspaces for the selected organization and paste one exact workspace ID.

capabilities.label: Read social analytics
capabilities.description: Read bounded identity-redacted profile references and aggregate audience, community-management, and content-performance metrics for one exact Agorapulse workspace.

approvalRequired.label: List Agorapulse profiles
approvalRequired.description: List at most 25 profile UIDs and network types without names, handles, avatars, biographies, or account identity.

approvalRequired.label: Read audience analytics
approvalRequired.description: Read aggregate audience metrics for one exact profile and a window of at most 31 days.

approvalRequired.label: Read community analytics
approvalRequired.description: Read aggregate community-management metrics for one exact profile and a window of at most 31 days.

approvalRequired.label: Read content analytics
approvalRequired.description: Read content-performance metrics with post content and identity removed for one exact profile and a window of at most 31 days.

blocked.label: Read identity or social content
blocked.description: Names, handles, emails, messages, post text, captions, URLs, media, biographies, and connected-account identity are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read broader analytics
blocked.description: Listening, custom reports, Social Media ROI reports, windows over 31 days, pagination, bulk access, and exports are outside V1.

blocked.label: Publish or manage inboxes
blocked.description: Drafts, calendar notes, scheduling, immediate publishing, media uploads, inbox reads, replies, labels, user notes, and all mutations are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary Agorapulse APIs
blocked.description: Arbitrary paths, methods, query parameters, request bodies, raw responses, and undocumented interfaces are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All four bounded reads require approval; identity, content, listening, broader reports, publishing, inbox access, writes, raw APIs, pagination, bulk, and export remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same four reads run directly; exact binding, static paths, redaction, 31-day windows, response caps, audits, and the provider's 500-per-30-minute quota remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts only four fixed, approval-gated, identity- and content-redacted reads for one exact organization and workspace.
Railway mounts only four fixed, approval-gated, identity- and content-redacted reads for one exact organization and workspace.

providerSetup.blocker: Agorapulse Open API access requires a Custom subscription, a customer-generated API key, and live validation against the intended organization and workspace. No approved customer credentials are available for acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized customer must obtain Open API access, generate a dedicated API key, select exact organization and workspace IDs, and connect them. Then validate health, redaction, report ranges, quota behavior, key replacement, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Official Analytics Open API availability on Custom plans, customer-generated API keys, organization/workspace/profile discovery, audience/content/community-management reports, read-only status, exclusions, and 500 requests per 30 minutes.
Official bearer authentication and fixed v1.0 organization, workspace, profile, audience, community-management, and content report routes.
Current API-key generation workflow, permission inheritance, supported report data, and provider-managed key deletion behavior.

securityNotes: Relay stores the customer-generated API key only as an encrypted secret and binds every request to one validated organization and workspace.
Only fixed GET routes under https://api.agorapulse.com are used. Redirects are rejected, report windows are capped at 31 days, arrays at 25 items, and responses at 2 MB.
Names, handles, emails, messages, text, titles, descriptions, URLs, media, authors, owners, profile identity, post content, and similar fields are removed recursively from report results.

Listening, custom and ROI reports, drafts, calendar notes, scheduling, publishing, media, inboxes, replies, labels, user notes, writes, arbitrary APIs, pagination, bulk access, and exports are unavailable.
Agorapulse documents 500 requests per 30 minutes. Relay enforces that local ceiling and propagates provider 429 responses; key invalidation remains provider-managed.
